author: eachann_

commands.name: codes
commands.title: 验证码

commands.name: manage-data
commands.title: 账户与数据
commands.subtitle: Goose 2FA
commands.description: 账户、分组、回收站、导入导出与数据源文件状态

commands.name: scan-qr
commands.title: 截图识码
commands.subtitle: Goose 2FA
commands.description: 截屏识别二维码或迁移码并导入账户

preferences.name: dataFile
preferences.title: 数据源文件
